concept_prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one premium, original visual identity concept sheet for FORGE, a proprietary institutional financial infrastructure protocol for traditional banks operating on Solana. It must communicate rigor, reliability, financial engineering and controlled operations. Art direction borrows the clarity of enterprise Swiss typography, flat squared geometry, restrained layouts, thin rules and a disciplined grid, with FORGE's own warm-industrial brand. Do NOT reproduce IBM, Solana, Stripe, HashiCorp or other existing logos. This is an original bank-infrastructure brand.

Landscape 3:2 graphic design presentation, pristine flat vector-style edges, professional identity studio quality. Palette strictly graphite ink #17232D, warm paper #F4F2ED, copper #A5482B, dark ink #121B22 and pale copper #E6A080 for reversed use. Neutral paper light background dominates. No photographic objects, 3D renders, foil, gradients, glass, glow, flames, hammers, coins, candlesticks, padlocks or shields. No stock mockup scenes. Build a strong flat silhouette that works at favicon scale. The main wordmark text must read FORGE, spelled F O R G E, uppercase, optically kerned, confident contemporary grotesk, not thin.

Layout: slim top-left concept label; generous upper two-thirds shows the main copper symbol with graphite FORGE wordmark in a spacious horizontal lockup. Thin horizontal separator. Lower third has three clearly aligned panels showing: small monochrome icon/wordmark on warm paper, white/pale-copper reverse version on dark ink, and a small solid copper application tile. Keep exactly the SAME symbol geometry across all panels. Very ample whitespace, all elements fully within the frame. Only include these words and the concept label requested; no extra explanatory paragraphs, no invented certifications.
CONCEPT LABEL: "01 / MONOLITH". Design a bold compact F monogram as a single continuous architectural silhouette, like a precisely machined metal profile. Use one substantial upright, a long top beam and shorter middle beam, with a clear rectangular inner counter and one distinctive 45-degree chamfer at the far upper-right end. Integrate a subtle structural notch so this does not look like a generic font letter F. The F is upright, balanced and instantly readable, not italic, not divided into horizontal stripes. Main copper mark roughly equal in height to the large FORGE wordmark cap height. The wordmark has a broad, steady stance and a clean open G. Recommended flagship direction, exceptionally confident and refined.

CONCEPT LABEL: "02 / KEYSTONE". Create an abstract architectural gate symbol with two strong asymmetrical vertical supports meeting under a flat top lintel. The negative space makes a subtle F-shaped opening or stepped passage. The emblem suggests a vault entrance and two independent approvals converging into one controlled passage, with absolutely no literal lock, shield or bank column. The outer form is compact and approximately square, geometric but distinctive, two interlocking copper masses separated by a precise negative-space seam. This must look substantially different from a plain F monogram. Give FORGE a calm medium-bold contemporary grotesk wordmark. Keep the gap and opening readable small.

CONCEPT LABEL: "03 / CUTWORD". This is a typography-led alternative. The MAIN logo is a custom standalone FORGE wordmark with NO separate emblem to its left. Design the five letters as wide, optically balanced, medium-bold industrial grotesk letterforms with one coherent custom detail: small precise diagonal terminal cuts on F, R and the opening of G. The G is visibly a G, the R has a strong diagonal leg, all five letters remain extremely legible. Main wordmark is graphite with a tiny copper square registration accent placed after the word, at cap baseline, as a brand signature. In the lower small-icon panel derive only the exact custom F from this wordmark as the app icon. In the dark panel show the complete same wordmark in warm paper with the copper square. Elegant and engineered, suitable on bank software, legal documents and developer documentation.

final_sheet_note: The final opaque comparison sheet replaces initial transparent presentation drafts. It preserves the concept shapes and uses a solid paper background with three equal columns and dark reverse-use panels.
